partner_context.their_ambition: Sun Siyam Resorts operates a Maldivian-born collection — Sun Siyam Iru Fushi, Olhuveli, Vilu Reef and Iru Veli — across multiple atolls, with a home-grown brand identity built on warm, characterful island hospitality. Its ambition is to make every arrival feel as distinctly Sun Siyam as the stay.
partner_context.their_pressure: Properties spread across atolls mean a mix of speedboat and seaplane transfers, each with its own weather exposure and cost — and a first impression that varies island to island instead of carrying one consistent brand signature.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: A branded N35 foiling fleet gives Sun Siyam a consistent, all-weather, zero-emission arrival across its islands — the same quiet, smooth welcome at every resort, operated to one standard.

hero.title: Navier × Sun Siyam Resorts — arrival as a product, across the operated collection
hero.subtitle: Re-platforming the airport-to-jetty transfer on foiling-electric vessels — silent, all-weather, zero-emission.
hero.what_we_do_together: Navier and Sun Siyam Resorts bring a foiling-electric arrival layer to its Maldivian islands. Navier supplies the software-defined N35 fleet, captain training and the certification path; Sun Siyam Resorts brings the resort relationships and the rollout sequence across its operated collection. The transfer stops being the weakest link in a premium stay and becomes a branded, all-weather, zero-emission arrival — the same calm quality on every island.

why_now: The Navier × JIH Global program — ~100 vessels, $100M, a three-year phased rollout with the first 5 boats in 2026 — proves, publicly and in Maldivian waters, that foiling-electric works at scale. For Sun Siyam Resorts, that removes the risk: the platform is real and ramping, and the only question is which of its islands to re-platform first.
multimodal_fit: Navier slots between Velana International and the Sun Siyam Resorts jetty — the highest-value leg of the guest journey — with seaplane retained only for the longest outer-atoll legs. The resort books and brands the experience; guests step from jet to foil to villa.

journeys_unlocked.today: 20–45 min in a diesel speedboat, rough in any swell, or a costly seaplane hop.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: A smooth, silent ~25-minute foiling transfer direct to the resort jetty — any weather, after dark.

journeys_unlocked.today: Seaplane only — daylight-limited, weather-cancelled, ~$600+ round trip.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: An all-weather, after-dark foiling link to the mid-atolls, complementing seaplane for the longest legs.

journeys_unlocked.today: Congested causeway road or a slow public ferry.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: A fast foiling commuter and visitor link across the capital's lagoon — the resident layer of the same program.

journeys_unlocked.today: A slow tender or a charter booked hours ahead.
journeys_unlocked.with_navier: On-demand premium island-hopping between islands, sandbanks and dive sites — the quiet in-stay water layer.

differentiation.why_navier: Sun Siyam is a Maldivian-born brand built on warm, characterful hospitality. Navier lets that brand own its arrival end to end — a distinctly Sun Siyam welcome on a silent foiling vessel, consistent across Iru Fushi, Olhuveli, Vilu Reef and Iru Veli, instead of a generic hop outsourced to a shared seaplane terminal.

proof_points.claim: Foiling-electric is already deploying at national scale in the Maldives.
proof_points.evidence: Navier × JIH Global: ~100 vessels / $100M / three-year phasing; first 5 boats in 2026.

proof_points.claim: The platform is proven in service.
proof_points.evidence: 10 vessels delivered, 4,000+ flight hours, 2025 production sold out.

proof_points.claim: For a home-grown brand, the arrival is a branding opportunity, not just transport.
proof_points.evidence: Today the first and last impression happens on a third-party seaplane or speedboat; a Sun Siyam-liveried foiling vessel makes the journey itself part of the brand.

proof_points.claim: A consistent welcome across the collection raises the floor everywhere.
proof_points.evidence: One foiling standard means the arrival feels as distinctly Sun Siyam at Vilu Reef as at the flagship Iru Fushi — no more variance between islands and transfer types.

objections.concern: Can a transfer really carry the brand the way our islands do?
objections.response: It's the first and last thing a guest experiences. A silent, characterful Sun Siyam-liveried arrival — rather than an anonymous shared seaplane — extends the brand to the one part of the trip it doesn't control today.

objections.concern: Our islands span atolls — can it handle the crossings and swell?
objections.response: The foil flies above the chop for a smoother ride than a diesel speedboat; the N35's enclosed all-weather cabin holds the experience together, and the Quanta-LR hybrid covers the longer crossings to Iru Fushi with no charging infrastructure.

objections.concern: Won't guests still need seaplanes for the further islands?
objections.response: Maldivian seaplanes fly in daylight only, costing late guests a night. A Quanta-LR foiling vessel reaches the further atolls and arrives after dark, turning a forced overnight into a same-night Sun Siyam welcome.

phases.label: Phase 1 — flagship-island pilot
phases.narrative: A focused pilot on Sun Siyam Resorts's busiest airport-to-jetty corridor — proving the all-weather N35 arrival on the island where the most guests will feel it.
phases.rationale: Start where transfer volume is highest and the arrival impression matters most.

phases.label: Phase 2 — portfolio-wide arrival network
phases.narrative: Scale the N35 arrival across Sun Siyam Resorts's islands and add Quanta-LR for the longer inter-property and outer-atoll legs — one branded, all-weather, zero-emission arrival layer spanning the whole operated collection.
phases.rationale: Extend the proven pilot to every island once operations and guest demand are validated.

phases.narrative: Roughly 100 vessels at steady state forming a national foiling transfer layer spanning the inhabited atoll chain — the world's first archipelago-scale foiling network, capitalised and built as a single multi-year program.
phases.rationale: Complete the three-year phased rollout to national coverage — the full realisation of the signed program.

the_ask.navier_brings: The software-defined N35 foiling fleet, captain training, the maintenance and certification path, and an operating playbook already being proven in Maldivian waters.
the_ask.partner_brings: Resort relationships across its operated collection, the island-by-island rollout sequence, jetty access and the guest-experience standard.
the_ask.next_step: Select Sun Siyam Resorts's first flagship island for a foiling-arrival pilot and define the portfolio rollout sequence.

close.title: The arrival, finally as good as the stay.
close.body: For Sun Siyam Resorts, the transfer has always been the one part of the journey that didn't match the islands. Foiling-electric closes that gap — a silent, all-weather, zero-emission arrival, the same quality on every island.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop — roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. Software-defined and autonomy-ready, the same fleet keeps improving over time.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists — the open ocean and the resort jetties already in use. No vertiports, no new rights-of-way. The N35 needs only a berth pedestal; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging infrastructure at all.
why_navier_now.the_moment: Decarbonization expectations turned diesel transfer fleets into a liability, the platform crossed from prototype to proven service, and a national-scale Maldives program is already live — the resort arrival layer is being re-platformed right now.

end_state.headline: A branded foiling arrival layer across the Sun Siyam Resorts operated collection.
end_state.addressable_footprint: Every Sun Siyam Resorts island in the Maldives, connected to Velana International and to each other by a fast, silent, zero-emission foiling fleet.

steady_state.total_corridors: Airport-to-jetty arrivals + inter-property and in-stay hops
steady_state.platform_mix: N35 for resort arrivals; Pioneer II for short in-stay hops; Quanta-LR for the longest inter-property legs
steady_state.tam_framing: Every guest arrival and in-stay transfer across the portfolio, re-platformed as one branded fleet.

end_state.narrative: Steady state is a Sun Siyam Resorts-branded foiling arrival network: jet-to-foil-to-villa on every island, the same calm quality end to end.
